units.source_text: 正月十四日照例举行男踏歌会，

en.t: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the men's toka singing ceremony was held as usual,

units.source_text: 尚侍玉鬘就在这一天入宫，

en.t: and the Naishi no Kami, Tamakazura, entered the palace on that very day,
with a ceremony as grand as could possibly be imagined.

units.source_text: 义父太政大臣与生父内大臣都来参与，

en.t: Her foster father, the Grand Minister, and her birth father, the Inner Minister, both came to take part,

units.source_text: 使得髭黑大将平添了威势。

en.t: which added still more prestige to General Higekuro.

units.source_text: 宰相中将夕雾诚恳地前来协助。

en.t: Yugiri, the Consultant Captain, came with sincere devotion to help.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的诸兄柏木等，乘此时机也一齐前来，

en.t: Tamakazura's brothers, including Kashiwagi, also seized this occasion to come together,

units.source_text: 悉心照料，体贴入微，实甚可喜。

en.t: and their careful attention and thoughtful care were truly delightful.

units.source_text: 尚侍的房室设在承香殿内东侧。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami's rooms were arranged on the eastern side of the Jokyoden.

units.source_text: 西侧便是式部卿亲王家的女御所居之处。

en.t: On the western side were the quarters of the nyogo from Prince Shikibukyo's household.

units.source_text: 中间只隔一条走廊，然而两人的心相隔甚远。

en.t: Only a corridor separated them, yet their hearts were very far apart.

units.source_text: 此时宫中许多妃嫔，互相争艳斗媚；

en.t: At this time many consorts in the palace competed with one another in beauty and charm;
jewels and bright ornaments filled the eye, and splendor was at its height.

units.source_text: 其中少有身份特别低微的更衣。

en.t: Among them there were few low-ranking ladies of the koi class.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后、弘徽殿女御、式部卿亲王家的女御，

en.t: Empress Akikonomu, the Kokiden nyogo, the nyogo from Prince Shikibukyo's household,
and the nyogo from the Left Minister's household,
all came today to lend their assistance.

units.source_text: 此外只有中纳言之女及宰相之女参与服务。

en.t: Apart from them, only the daughter of a Middle Counselor and the daughter of a Consultant took part in the service.
